meta.title: Recreate Order: Delivery date in the past

plan.title: Recreate Order Rejects Past Delivery Date

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary page.
Open the stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order dialog.

args.goal: in the Recreate Order dialog, attempt to select yesterday as the Delivery Date and verify whether yesterday is unavailable or Create Order refuses the past date; record which outcome occurs

steps.note: The catalog has no relative-date picker or dedicated Recreate Order validation step, so perform the buyer-side interaction and verify the refusal on screen.
Confirm the refusal interaction did not leave the screen in an error or crashed state.
